name: freeactors-hsm-editor
description: Visual hierarchical state machine editor that generates C++17 active objects for FreeRTOS on Arm Cortex-M, with a simulator, generated tests and runtime trace.

scripts.watch:lib: nodemon --watch freeactors_lib -e hpp,h,cpp --exec npm run copy-lib
scripts.watch: npm run copy-lib && npm run watch:tsc
scripts.copy-lib: mkdir -p out/freeactors_lib && cp -r freeactors_lib/* out/freeactors_lib/ && rm -f out/freeactors_lib/fa_mempool.hpp out/freeactors_lib/linenoise.hpp && cp tools/fa-trace.js out/fa-trace.js
